title: Constructibility is transitive for a space with a basis of quasi-compact opens
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a space with a basis of quasi-compact opens, a subset constructible in a constructible subset is constructible in the space (author lemma at source lines 2979-2985, label lemma-constructible-in-constructible). The proof (source lines 2987-3008) prepares the induced basis, reduces to a single difference of retrocompact opens by taking traces, and handles that case by factoring the inclusion through the retrocompact open and applying the two pullback statements (proof lines 2987-3007). The reduction to the single piece is the substance. H3.
